svg.aria-label: Kinexys control box: a client agent's FX request rides a rail as a trade slip in a robot cart's basket and slides into JPMorgan Kinexys' control box. The box checks identity, a $5M ceiling and a £4.5M balance floor — the two dials on its top — and only then does the stamped trade ticket drop down the chute into the output tray. A request outside the box is stamped into the reject bin. The identity drum holds the three checks (identity, authority, limits); the gauge is Kinexys' daily volume. Verified numbers: $5M ceiling example and £4.5M floor from the November 17–18, 2026 demonstration; $4T+ cumulative Kinexys volume, ~$7B/day average; first private-blockchain test between autonomous bank and client agents, simulated, no real money moved.
svg.text: $5M ceiling · £4.5M floor · $4T Kinexys volume · ~$7B/day · 0 humans · simulated
